steps.en: Install Docker and the Switch Console desktop app
steps.zh: 装好 Docker 和 Switch Console 桌面应用

steps.en: Choose to run Switch on this computer, then press Start
steps.zh: 选择在本机运行 Switch，再点 Start

steps.en: Starts a local Switch server and its Postgres in Docker
steps.zh: 在 Docker 里起本机 Switch 服务器和 Postgres

steps.en: Ask switch-buddy to connect Slack, paste the app details, link your account
steps.zh: 让 switch-buddy 帮你接 Slack，粘贴应用信息并关联账号
steps.code: Help me connect Slack to Switch.

steps.en: Creates an agent on your signed-in Claude Code or Codex and a room bound to a channel
steps.zh: 建好跑在你 Claude Code 或 Codex 上的 agent 和频道房间

steps.en: @mention the agent in that Slack channel
steps.zh: 在那个 Slack 频道里 @ 这个 agent

steps.en: Routes the message to the agent's session; its reply lands in the same thread
steps.zh: 把消息送进该 agent 的会话，回复落回同一线程

value.en: Your existing coding agent works in the team's channel with the whole thread as context — nobody copies chat into a terminal or learns a new app
value.zh: 你已有的编码 agent 直接在团队频道里干活、带着整条线程的上下文——没人再把聊天记录搬进终端，也不用学新应用
